title: SEBI Eyes Tata Steel–APL Deal & RBI CRR Change 🏛️ | StickBiz Brief | 28 Nov 2026
ticker: SEBI examines Tata Steel–APL Apollo ₹28,000 crore deal
RBI cuts daily CRR minimum to 90% from 1 December
Zee's ₹600 crore buyback at ₹91 opens 1 December
Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO; US stocks rise

quote.text: Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.

segments.headline: SEBI eyes Tata-APL deal · RBI eases daily CRR rule
segments.cap: A ₹28,000 crore deal has SEBI watching closely. And the RBI changes a key rule for banks.
segments.tts: [excited] A twenty-eight thousand crore rupee deal has SEBI watching closely. And the RBI changes a key rule for banks.

segments.headline: SEBI eyes Tata-APL deal
segments.cap: SEBI is looking closely at the Tata Steel and APL Apollo deal. Tata Steel will sell its tubes businesses to APL Apollo for ₹28,000 crore. Proxy advisers warn that minority shareholders could carry the cost. SEBI has now given Tata Steel until 8 December to publish its open offer statement.
segments.tts: [excited] SEBI is looking closely at the Tata Steel and APL Apollo deal. Tata Steel will sell its tubes businesses to APL Apollo for twenty-eight thousand crore rupees. Proxy advisers warn that minority shareholders could carry the cost. SEBI has now given Tata Steel until the eighth of December to publish its open offer statement.

head: IS SEBI
WATCHING?
beats.note: The regulator says it is *looking at the deal*, because a *takeover and an offer* are involved.

head: APL BUYS
TATA'S TUBES
beats.note: Tata Steel moves its *tubes and colour-coated* businesses to APL Apollo.

head: WHO PAYS
THE COST?
beats.note: Investors fear a *disproportionate share* of cost and risk falls on *minority shareholders.*

head: MORE TIME
TILL 8 DEC
beats.note: The original deadline was *1 December*, and Tata Steel asked for the *extra time.*

segments.headline: RBI eases daily CRR rule
segments.cap: From 1 December, the RBI will ease a rule for banks. The daily minimum for the cash reserve ratio falls from 99% to 90%. Banking liquidity has slipped into deficit, pushing short-term rates higher. A 25 basis point rate hike is widely expected at the next policy review.
segments.tts: [excited] From the first of December, the RBI will ease a rule for banks. The daily minimum for the cash reserve ratio falls from ninety-nine percent to ninety percent. Banking liquidity has slipped into deficit, pushing short-term rates higher. A twenty-five basis point rate hike is widely expected at the next policy review.

head: RBI EASES
BANK RULE
beats.note: CRR is the slice of deposits that banks must keep with the *RBI*, and it earns *no interest.*

head: 99% TO
beats.note: The overall CRR stays at *3%*; only the *daily* minimum is relaxed.

head: CASH IS
GETTING TIGHT
beats.note: With the system in *deficit*, short-term borrowing costs have *hardened.*

head: RATE HIKE
AHEAD?
beats.note: Economists widely expect a *25 basis point hike*, though some see room for a *larger one.*

segments.headline: Zee buyback opens 1 Dec
segments.cap: Zee Entertainment's ₹600 crore share buyback opens on 1 December and closes on 7 December. The price is ₹91 per share. The promoters will not take part.
segments.tts: [excited] Zee Entertainment's six hundred crore rupees share buyback opens on the first of December and closes on the seventh of December. The price is ninety-one rupees per share. The promoters will not take part.

head: ZEE'S ₹600 CR
BUYBACK
beats.note: The company buys back its own shares through a *tender offer*, with bids settled by *14 December.*

head: PROMOTERS
STAY OUT
beats.note: The offer price is *₹91 per share*, and the *promoters* have chosen not to participate.

segments.headline: Huang returns to Nvidia
segments.cap: Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia's CEO, after resigning on 12 November. Nvidia shares jumped sharply on the news. Donald Trump says he helped bring him back. US stocks rose on Friday, with tech leading.
segments.tts: [excited] Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia's CEO, after resigning on the twelfth of November. Nvidia shares jumped sharply on the news. Donald Trump says he helped bring him back. US stocks rose on Friday, with tech leading.

head: NVIDIA'S CEO
IS BACK
beats.note: Huang left on *12 November*, and the board later *reinstated him.*

head: SHARES
JUMP FAST
beats.note: Trump told CNBC he *stepped in*, and the stock *jumped sharply* on the return.

head: WALL STREET
ENDS HIGHER
beats.note: *US indexes rose* on Friday, with *technology stocks* leading the move.
